Knife-edge & dominant shots

Generated 2026-08-26 by flippers-gen.mjs from 20 sweep runs in corners/*/sweep-results.json (72 distinct shots, 1824 per-shot measurements). A “measurement” is one shot’s ΔRMSE under one constants change in one study.

Dominant: ≥3 swings ≥10 cm or worst swing ≥20 cm — it blows out the tails of parameter studies. Knife-edge: swings in both directions (≥±5 cm, at least four ≥5 cm) — its fit lands in different trajectory regimes depending on constants/seed. Either = removal candidate; both is worst. Thresholds calibrated to the breakout tier (quiet majority: median worst-swing ~7 cm).
